# 行舟 · 个人行动与生活系统 v0.6.0

这是行舟从“项目与事务中心”扩展为“个人行动与生活系统”的一次重要更新。新版加入独立的“生活节律”一级模块，在保留项目管理能力的同时，将科研工作、身体状态、个人生活与恢复放进同一套本地系统。

## 主要更新

- “项目与事务”和“生活节律”成为两个独立的一级模块，各自拥有清晰的二级导航。
- 新增今日记录、历史数据、评分标准和时间线，以及科研工作日、周六轻量复盘、周日半日科研和休假／节假日四种日期类型。
- 每日记录提供分阶段填写、小时与分钟下拉输入、睡眠时长、kg/lb 体重、自动工作边界判断和五套内嵌评分规则。
- “昨晚熄灯”和“今日起床”保存为明确的跨日日期时间；下班后工作闭环区分“尚未确认／不需要／需要”，不需要时不会把空时长误记为 0。
- 生活节律由独立的 `daily-records.json` 保存，拥有三份轮换备份和写后复核；它从空仓库开始，不会读取或迁移旧的每日数据文档。
- 提供按日期范围读取每日记录和读取评分规则的只读接口，为后续周报、月报与 AI 分析预留连接点。
- 同时改进本周跨日工作项、今日层级提示、Markdown 阅读态、列表续写与编辑器自动高度。

## 升级说明

本版本不会迁移“改变2026·每日数据”或其他旧每日文档。生活节律首次打开时建立空仓库，原有“项目与事务”内部数据继续保留。建议升级后重新加载插件，再开始录入当天数据。

## 下载

请下载本 Release 附件中的 `package.zip`。不要使用 GitHub 自动生成的 Source code 压缩包作为思源插件包。

完整记录见 [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Yong2Sheng/siyuan-plugin-xingzhou/blob/v0.6.0/CHANGELOG.md)。

# Xingzhou · Personal Action & Life System v0.6.0

This major update expands Xingzhou from a project-and-task center into a personal action and life system. The new standalone Life Rhythm module brings research work, wellbeing, personal life, and recovery into the same local-first system while preserving the existing project-management workflow.

## Highlights

- Projects & Tasks and Life Rhythm are now separate top-level modules with their own second-level navigation.
- Added Today, History, Rubrics, and Timeline views, plus profiles for research workdays, Saturday reset, Sunday half-day research, and holidays.
- Daily records include staged entry, hour/minute selectors, sleep duration, kg/lb weight units, automatic work-boundary evaluation, and five embedded scoring rubrics.
- Lights-off and wake values retain explicit dates for cross-day sleep. Optional after-work closure uses Pending / Not needed / Needed states, so not-needed durations are never misread as zero.
- Life Rhythm uses its own `daily-records.json`, three rotating backups, and read-after-write verification. It starts empty and never reads or migrates the legacy daily-data document.
- Read-only date-range and rubric APIs provide integration points for future weekly, monthly, and AI-assisted analysis.
- This release also improves multi-day Week items, Today hierarchy indicators, Markdown viewing, list continuation, and editor auto-sizing.

## Upgrade notes

This release does not migrate “改变2026·每日数据” or any other legacy daily document. Life Rhythm creates an empty store on first use, while existing Projects & Tasks internal data remains intact. Reload the plugin after upgrading, then begin entering the current day's record.
